description: This file defines a React functional component 'KeywordModal' which provides a UI modal for adding a blocked keyword, selecting an action ('BLOCK' or 'MASK'), and optionally providing a description. It uses components from 'antd' and '@tremor/react'.

methods.name: KeywordModal
